content:
This month, Apple will unveil its first foldable iPhone—reportedly named the iPhone Ultra. The device is said to feature a 5.5-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch inner display. Samsung launched the all-new Galaxy Z Fold 8 back in July, which shares those exact same screen sizes.

Whether Samsung released this phone just to beat the iPhone Ultra to the punch is another matter—but regardless, the Galaxy Z Fold 8 already gives us a rough idea of what the iPhone Ultra might feel like in real-world use.

Reviewers who got early hands-on time with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 have been flooding Twitter with comparison shots against other devices. Since the iPhone Ultra and Galaxy Z Fold 8 share similar dimensions, these comparisons offer a sneak peek at how the iPhone Ultra will look and feel in real-life scenarios.

Ray Wong posted several comparison shots of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 against the previous-generation iPad mini, highlighting how it truly delivers an iPad mini-like display in your pocket—and with even slimmer bezels.

Meanwhile, enthusiast Shishir shared comparison photos of the iPhone 13 mini against the Galaxy Z Fold 8. The iPhone 13 mini stands slightly taller than this foldable, but both are equally compact. For those who miss the iPhone mini lineup, the iPhone Ultra might just bring back that feeling.

Speaking for myself, after spending some hands-on time with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 last week, I'm actually more excited for the iPhone Ultra than ever before. The two are nearly identical in size (though the iPhone Ultra will reportedly feature rounded corners)—so until we see it in the flesh in September, this is about as good a preview as we'll get of what Apple has up its sleeve.

Of course, you can also check out dummy model photos for further comparisons.
